```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/helpers.R")
library(leaflet)
library(DT)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)

firms <- load_materials_firms("data/materials.yml")
```

## Overview

The machines that deposit, etch, and pattern silicon, and the wafers and chemicals those machines consume — the supply chain feeding every fab and OSAT tracked elsewhere on this site. As of `r format(Sys.Date(), "%B %Y")`, this tracker covers **`r nrow(firms)` firms**.

## Firm Map

```{r map, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
firms$colour <- unname(sapply(firms$segment, segment_color))
firms$primary_segment <- trimws(sapply(strsplit(firms$segment, ",", fixed = TRUE), `[`, 1))
popups <- vapply(1:nrow(firms), function(i) make_materials_popup(firms[i, ]), character(1))

segment_order <- c("Lithography", "Etch", "Deposition", "CMP", "Photoresist", "Specialty Gas", "Wafers", "Cleaning")
legend_segments <- c(segment_order[segment_order %in% unique(firms$primary_segment)],
                     setdiff(unique(firms$primary_segment), segment_order))

leaflet(firms, options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 3, maxZoom = 10)) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas) %>%
  fitBounds(lng1 = 73, lat1 = 18, lng2 = 135, lat2 = 53) %>%
  add_boundary_layers() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, radius = 8,
    color = "#ffffff", fillColor = ~colour, fillOpacity = 0.85, stroke = TRUE, weight = 1.5,
    popup = popups,
    popupOptions = popupOptions(maxWidth = 320, minWidth = 220, maxHeight = 360, autoPan = TRUE, keepInView = TRUE, autoPanPadding = c(20, 20))
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors = unname(sapply(legend_segments, segment_color)),
    labels = legend_segments,
    title = "Primary Segment"
  )
```

## All Firms

```{r table, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
table_data <- firms %>%
  mutate(
    Name = paste0('<a href="equipment-firms/', id, '.html">', name_en, '</a>'),
    Segment = factor(primary_segment),
    CategoryF = factor(category),
    Designation = factor(ifelse(entity_list_flagged, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes")),
    Node = node_capability
  ) %>%
  select(Name, Category = CategoryF, Segment, "Node Capability" = Node, Designation)

datatable(table_data, escape = FALSE, filter = list(position = "top", clear = TRUE), options = list(pageLength = 15, dom = "ftip"), rownames = FALSE)
```
